features.title: New protocol detection
features.function: Identifies an NCCP regimen that appears in a monitored catalogue but is not yet registered in SACTCheck.
features.strength: Makes newly published treatment options visible to the maintenance team instead of relying on occasional manual catalogue review.

features.title: Updated protocol detection
features.function: Flags a registered regimen when its version, official source address or source content changes.
features.strength: Provides a reproducible signal that an encoded regimen may need reconciliation against a newer source.

features.title: Silent replacement detection
features.function: Detects a changed PDF even when the visible version label and web address remain the same.
features.strength: Reduces the risk that an unnoticed document replacement leaves SACTCheck linked to an outdated interpretation.

features.title: Removed protocol detection
features.function: Identifies a previously registered source that is no longer present in the successfully scanned NCCP catalogue pages.
features.strength: Prompts review of whether a regimen has been retired, moved or temporarily unavailable before its status is changed in SACTCheck.

features.title: Clinical significance triage
features.function: Groups detected text changes into treatment criteria, safety workflow, information or formatting categories.
features.strength: Helps reviewers prioritise possible dose, schedule, eligibility, laboratory and toxicity changes while retaining human confirmation.

features.title: Previous and current source comparison
features.function: Preserves the earlier and current source context so changed passages can be shown together for review.
features.strength: Creates a faster and more transparent review pathway than rereading two complete protocol documents without guidance.

features.title: Mandatory human review gate
features.function: Prevents a detected source change from automatically rewriting any clinical rule or treatment action.
features.strength: Keeps clinical interpretation, approval and release control with authorised reviewers.

features.title: Change history and provenance
features.function: Records the source identity, detection date, review state and SACTCheck release that incorporates an approved change.
features.strength: Provides an auditable maintenance trail for governance, validation and future external review.
